newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues Telecom says has 150,000 phone clients.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Telecom says has 150,000 phone clients.

text.p: Private French mobile telephone operator Bouygues Telecom said Wednesday it had reached a total of nearly 150,000 clients since its launch a year ago and said its network was expanding quickly.
In a statement, it said its network currently covered 28 percent of the French population, with coverage in the Paris basin, the Rhone Alps region and the Cote d'Azur.
"Between now and the ennd of the year, 50 percent of the French population will be covered before reaching 80 percent by the end of 1998 and more than 90 percent by mid-1999," it said.

French telecoms supervisor ART said on May 9 there were nearly three million mobile telephones in France in April, of which Bouygues had 125,000 after increasing the number of its subscriptions by 15.4 percent during that month.
Bouygues Telecom is part of the French construction company Bouygues.
